response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, f.articount::numeric / NULLIF(t.artifact_total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.value AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
